第15章 极道帝兵显威镇压一切（第1页）
“叶楚尘，不管怎么说，你都是我叶家人，都是我亲弟弟！”
“就算父亲跟你断绝关係，就算你已经被从族谱除名，被逐出叶家，那又如何？”
“你想要离开叶家，我叶凌月不同意！也绝不答应！”
天妖峡內，拥有神火境八重天修为的大姐叶凌月，脚踏虚空，黑髮狂舞，凌空而立，隨著手指不停地结印，恐怖的灵力冲天而起。
圣器十三星耀宝鐲绽放出恐怖的神华，毁天灭地的圣级威压更是笼罩周遭百米，禁錮一切。
“这天妖峡危险无比，楚尘你先跟大姐回去。”
“等回到叶家，只要你跟父亲低头认个错，跟小轩道个歉，跟灵儿她们解释解释。”
“我相信有我在，他们不会为难你的！”
很显然，在叶凌月这个大姐的內心深处，错的依旧是他楚尘！
只不过跟叶鼎、叶清情和叶灵儿等人比起来，她叶凌月自以为对楚尘更好，把亲情看得更重。
眼看在言语上说服不了冥顽不灵、顽固不化的楚尘，叶凌月便想著武力镇压，强行把楚尘带回叶家，再论其它。
听到叶凌月打著“长姐如母”的名义，苦口婆心说这都是为了自己好，实则已经祭出圣器开始镇压自己，他楚尘都被气笑了：
“滚吧！我跟你们叶家人没什么好说的了。”
第一次被楚尘这个废物指责和谩骂，叶凌月脸色微变，无论是从身份还是实力上来说，楚尘有什么资格指责自己这个姐姐？
更別说，她叶凌月这么做，可都是为了他楚尘好！！
“我不知道我闭关这段时间发生了什么，但我今日一定要带你回叶家，因为我答应过母亲会照顾好你！”
恐怖的圣级威压尽数爆发，叶凌月显然已经没有耐心了，数百米之巨圣器十三星耀宝鐲包裹著楚尘的身体极具收缩，眨眼的时间便化作一个碗口大小，飞向手腕。
圣器內自成空间，楚尘一个筋脉寸断、修为被废的凡夫俗子，在圣器面前，毫无招架之力。
在叶凌月看来，只要她认真起来，別说反抗和挣扎，他楚尘连说话的权利都没有！！
当圣器十三星耀宝鐲將楚尘强行收入其內部空间那一剎那，体內的极道帝兵吞天魔罐感受到威胁，便开始自行復甦。
只可惜楚尘体內没有丝毫灵力，根本催动不了吞天魔罐这尊极道帝兵。
而叶凌月虽然动用圣器，但却对楚尘没有杀心，只是禁錮住楚尘的身体，限制其行动。
吞天魔罐只是初步被炼化，只有在楚尘遭受到性命之危时才会復甦，强行护主。
“叶凌月，我楚尘早已叛出叶家！”
“今日我就是死，也绝不可能跟你回叶家！”
被圣器禁錮住的楚尘赤红著双眼，仰天长啸。
一股恐怖到极点的能量在其体內酝酿、吞吐，如同即將爆发的活火山，恢宏，浩大！
即便还未爆发，但此神威有山呼海啸般威能，镇压一切。
楚尘现在確实操纵不了吞天魔罐这尊极道帝兵，但豁出去拼得身陨道消，控制吞天魔罐当场自爆，却还是能做得到的。
一尊极道帝兵自爆，那威力能有多大？
届时別说叶凌月这个神火境强者，別说十三星耀宝鐲这尊圣器，怕是连整个遮天蔽日的天妖峡都將被强行夷为平地。

Chapter 15 The Ji Dao Emperor’s soldiers show their power and suppress everything (page 1)
"Ye Chuchen, no matter what, you are part of my Ye family and my biological brother!"
"Even if your father disowns you, even if you have been removed from the family tree and expelled from the Ye family, so what?"
"You want to leave the Ye family, but I, Ye Lingyue, don't agree! I will never agree!"
In the Tianyao Gorge, the eldest sister Ye Lingyue, who possesses the eighth level of divine fire realm, stands in the air with her feet on the void, her black hair dancing wildly, and as her fingers keep making seals, terrifying spiritual power rises into the sky.
The sacred weapon's eleven-star shining treasure bracelet bloomed with terrifying divine brilliance, and the holy-level pressure that destroyed the heaven and earth shrouded the surroundings for hundreds of meters, imprisoning everything.
"This Tianyao Gorge is extremely dangerous. Chu Chen, please go back with eldest sister first."
"When you return to the Ye family, all you need to do is bow your head to your father and admit your mistake, apologize to Xiaoxuan, and explain to Ling'er and the others."
"I believe that as long as I'm here, they won't make things difficult for you!"
Obviously, deep in the heart of Ye Lingyue, the eldest sister, it was still Chu Chen who was wrong!
But compared to Ye Ding, Ye Qingqing, Ye Ling'er and others, she, Ye Lingyue, thought she was better to Chu Chen and valued family ties more.
Seeing that she could not persuade the stubborn and stubborn Chu Chen with words, Ye Lingyue thought of suppressing it with force and forcibly bringing Chu Chen back to Ye's house before talking about anything else.
Hearing that Ye Lingyue, in the name of "eldest sister is like mother", said sincerely that this was all for her own good, but in fact she had already sacrificed the sacred weapon and started to suppress herself, Chu Chen was so angry that he laughed:
"Go away! I have nothing more to say to your Ye family."
Ye Lingyue's face changed slightly when she was accused and abused by Chu Chen, a loser for the first time. In terms of status and strength, what qualifications did Chu Chen have to accuse his sister?
Not to mention, Ye Lingyue did this all for his own good, Chu Chen! !
"I don't know what happened during my retreat, but I must take you back to Ye's house today because I promised my mother that I would take good care of you!"
The terrifying saint-level pressure exploded, and Ye Lingyue obviously had no patience. The hundreds of meters of giant sacred weapon, the eleven-star shining bracelet, wrapped around Chu Chen's body and shrank extremely. In the blink of an eye, it turned into the size of a bowl mouth and flew towards his wrist.
The sacred vessel formed its own space. Chu Chen, a mortal with broken muscles and ruined cultivation, was helpless in front of the sacred vessel.
In Ye Lingyue's view, as long as she takes it seriously, Chu Chen doesn't even have the right to speak, let alone resist and struggle! !
The moment the sacred artifact, the Eleven-Three-Star Shining Treasure Bracelet, forced Chu Chen into its inner space, the Jidao Emperor's Heaven-Swallowing Devil Jar in his body felt threatened and began to revive on its own.
It's a pity that Chu Chen doesn't have any spiritual power in his body, so he can't activate the heaven-swallowing magic jar, the ultimate emperor weapon.
Although Ye Lingyue used the holy weapon, she had no murderous intentions towards Chu Chen. She only imprisoned Chu Chen's body and restricted his movements.
The Sky-Swallowing Magic Jar has only been initially refined, and will only revive when Chu Chen is in danger of life and forcefully protect its master.
"Ye Lingyue, I, Chu Chen, have already betrayed the Ye family!"
"Even if I die today, I will never go back to Ye's house with you!"
Chu Chen, who was imprisoned by the holy weapon, looked up to the sky and screamed with red eyes.
An extremely terrifying energy is brewing and swallowing in his body, like an active volcano about to erupt, magnificent and vast!
Even if it has not exploded yet, this divine power is as powerful as a roaring mountain and a tsunami, suppressing everything.
It is true that Chu Chen cannot control the Heaven-Swallowing Magic Jar, an extremely powerful imperial weapon, but he can still do it by risking his life and controlling the Heaven-Swallowing Magic Jar to explode on the spot.
If a Jidao Emperor's weapon self-destructs, how powerful can it be?
By then, not to mention Ye Lingyue, a powerful person in the Divine Fire Realm, not to mention the sacred artifact of the 11-Three-Star Shining Treasure Bracelet, I am afraid that even the entire Tianyao Gorge, which covers the sky and the sun, will be forcibly razed to the ground.
